violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Multiple food items were observed Adulterated by pest activity. Candy, chocolate, crackers, rice, cookies, canned goods and pet food were observed with gnawed packaging and pest excrement visual. Establishment is to visual inspect all food items for evidence of adulteration. All adulterated food items are to be segregated from unadulterated food for disposal. Establishment is to complete internal procedure for Disposal. Once establishment has completed internal procedure, they are to contact RIDOH CFP to complete disposal. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The presence of pests is not controlled as evidenced by widespread rodent droppings, gnawed food items, and nesting material. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Corrective Action - Pest control company to complete a full evaluation of the interior and exterior of establishment. Establishment is to increase pest control. Establishment is to clean and sanitize any and all area with rodent activity. All pest control evaluations and reports must be sent to RIDOH CFP. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/20/2026
Bottled water and soda were observed stored on the floor in the back room and sales floor. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The back of the aisle shelving was observed in poor repair. Non Food contact surfaces must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of food shelving (Pet food aisle, Cereal Aisle, Candy Aisle, Cooking/Cracker Aisle, Canned Good Aisle, back storage area) have an accumulation of rodent droppings, dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Establishment is to clean and sanitize and any all shelves with rodent activity. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The floor in the establishment area has an accumulation of pest droppings soil residue and food debris (under shelving, behind refrigeration, back storage room) . The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. All areas with rodent droppings are to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back room) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Establishment is to move all equipment and items at least 6 inches off wall. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the milk and egg refrigerators have an accumulation of mold, dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The shelving and mats in the refrigerators were observed with an excess of debris. Shelving and mats that can not be cleaned must be replaced. Establishment is to keep product in other refrigerator until coolers have been professionally cleaned for mold removal. Establishment is to send photos of completed work to RIDOH. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025
The ceiling tile by the air condition vent is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2025

The door to the outside, located in the front of the store, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the milk and egg refrigerators have an accumulation of mold, dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The shelving and mats in the refrigerators were observed with an excess of debris. Shelving and mats that can not be cleaned must be replaced. Establishment is to move product to other refrigerator until coolers have been professionally cleaned for mold removal. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025
The ceiling tiles in the establishment were observed with water damage. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2025

The air conditioning vents in the establishment were observed with an accumulation of mold, and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2025
